purpose: resolve components whose selected feature level / structure is unstable across temporal periods (Phase 1B selected on 2024 wk13-18 only)
data: burned data only (2022 warm-up through 2026 wk3). No clean-forward data. No random CV.
per_fold_procedure: hierarchical hyper-parameters (decay, kappas) and tilt l2 are RE-TUNED inside each fold on an inner validation block = the last 25% of the fold's training weeks; the model is then refit on the full training window and scored on the test block. Feature values are as-of (week-level), unchanged.
score: primary = per-opportunity log score (pmf / hazard) or per-record negative log pmf (defender counts); CRPS is reported as a secondary check where defined. Fold scores are equal-weight averaged across folds (fold-size-weighted average also reported).
candidate_ladder: B0 < B1 < B2 < B3 < B4 < B5 (nested feature families: hierarchical only, +team, +opponent, +scheme, +personnel, +interaction). Rushing additionally: single-process < two-process (T=15/20/25) compared at the chosen level.

adjudication_rule.step: visit the remaining candidates in ladder order; a candidate C replaces the currently kept candidate K only if ALL hold
conditions: mean fold improvement (score_K - score_C, equal-weight) >= 0.05% of K's mean score (materiality)
C beats K in at least 5 of the 7 folds (sign consistency)
worst single-fold degradation of C vs K is no larger than the materiality threshold (0.05% of K's mean score)
adjudication_rule.parsimony: ties and failures keep the simpler candidate; statistical significance of a tiny pooled difference is NOT sufficient
adjudication_rule.no_period_cherry_picking: the rule uses all seven folds; no fold, period or family is excluded after seeing results

consumers: Phase 1C consumes exactly the adjudicated component versions; the Phase 1B validation-only selections are superseded

amendment_1.reason: A first run (kept, labelled run1_including_2022_wk1 in adjudication_run1_partial.json) trained on 2022 week-1 rows whose as-of features are identically zero (empty stores; verified: team/opponent context features are 0.000 for every 2022 wk1 row). Phase 1B's TRAIN window already excluded 2022. Run 1 showed every defender feature level worse than B0 in 7/7 folds by 0.04+ nats, an artifact signature.
amendment_1.change: rows of 2022 week 1 (no as-of history exists) are excluded from fold training, inner validation and testing for every component. All other rows, all folds and all rule thresholds are unchanged. Run 1 partial results are retained for transparency; only run 2 decides.
